purpose: Story 1.1 (epic-candidate-rig): restore the demo Firebase emulator backend from the hash-verified staged export into a new container, new output directories and new loopback ports, and prove a control save/stop/start cycle retains the saved data.

restoreVerification.manifestRecipe: cd <staged export> && find "$PWD" -type f | sort | xargs sha256sum | sha256sum

controlSave.command: docker exec -w /tmp schoolquiz-demo-firebase-20261004 firebase emulators:export /tools/firebase-output-root/control-save-1 --config /repo/firebase.mvp.json --project demo-schoolquiz-mvp --non-interactive

restartCycle.stop: docker stop fired --export-on-exit; export-on-exit output: 12 files, 98 auth users
restartCycle.start: docker start re-imported the read-only staged export (logs confirm /tools/firebase-import source)

deviations: Spec spot-check 'seasons/5990-Q4' exists as 'arena_seasons/5990-Q4' in this backend.
Wallet fields live on users/<uid> (718 docs with lifePoints/standardHearts/goldHearts), not profiles/<uid>; profiles carry uid/nickname/syntheticCatalogRun.
history: 0 documents before and after restart; staged export LevelDB contains no history kind markers, so the restored state is byte-faithful to the canonical staged baseline.
emulators:export in firebase-tools here takes the export path positionally (no --export-dir flag) and requires a writable cwd plus explicit --config.
